# Navo v1.0.0

Navo’s first public release brings a shared music player to Windows and Android, built on upstream Naviamp with a new identity, generated radio stations, and an adaptive browsing and playback experience.

## Highlights

- Play your own music on Windows and Android, including Android TV and Google TV.
- Preview, save, refresh, and replay generated radio stations without losing their seeds or tuning.
- Keep playlists, lyrics, favorites, and playback close at hand in an adaptive five-destination interface.

## Features

- Navo launches on Windows and Android, including Android TV and Google TV, with its own blue-arrow artwork and independent release channel. ([Issue #1](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/issues/1), [PR #2](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/pull/2))
- Connect Navidrome, Subsonic/OpenSubsonic, Jellyfin, Bandcamp, or Aurral. Browse your library, manage playlists, download music, and listen with native BASS playback, gapless transitions, ReplayGain, and crossfade where supported. Built on @ursasmar’s upstream application. ([Accepted source](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/464741058b58a1cec2c7e0afed4eeadc8cd746f0))
- Build generated radio from artists, albums, genres, or songs. Preview and save station recipes, refresh a batch, replay its exact order, or save it as a playlist. Stations retain their seeds and tuning as playback continues. ([Implementation](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/da8f1c306c89b98cb81e8ab37ad94408a5f0c452))
- Explore personalized Home mixes and a dedicated Radio destination with Server Radio and Internet Radio tabs. Sonic discovery follows the similarity capabilities of your server. ([Radio tabs](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/45d6129c755229ebadd0d07ddc11e5759c4f9aba), [Generated stations](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/da8f1c306c89b98cb81e8ab37ad94408a5f0c452))
- Browse Home, Playlists, Library, Radio, and My with adaptive navigation. Open one expanded player, control playback from the mini-player, and keep Queue in a drawer or pinned beside lyrics. ([Player navigation](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/4cac272f4013367b9b064a4870e1ba82b61c5573), [Mini-player controls](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/76be572034f0fd16ba27230ed0244644e8f11327))
- Resume playlists from their saved track and position, pin playlists, albums, and artists to Quick Access, filter Library favorites, and pull down to refresh browsing pages. ([Playlist resume](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/d3e444f38459742190842c43a7d841b72f1944d9), [Pull-down refresh](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/ab87a2178e3fcaf81ae761d928b09def0168cdc1))
- Follow synchronized or plain lyrics with online fallback, cached results, next-track prefetch, adjustable text size, and timed scrolling for untimed lyrics. Choose Naviamp or Forest themes, Light/Dark/System mode, and artwork-inspired player backgrounds. ([Lyrics cache](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/8c3c5c2ec9946346f668170a1bbff9a09d263749), [Lyrics defaults](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commit/6c8b691a7d721e00ecc23899565446bb8178a203))
- Use Android Auto, Android TV remote navigation, Google Cast, and Navo Connect remote control (beta). Settings backup and folder sync carry supported preferences between devices. Includes inherited TV controls implemented and tested by @crsthn-slv. ([Upstream issue #459](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/459), [Upstream PR #463](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/463))

## Upgrade notes

- This is the first public Navo release, not an update to upstream Naviamp. The cn.com.letalk.navo application identity does not automatically migrate upstream or earlier cn.com.letalk.naviamp data or credentials. Export and import shared settings deliberately, reconnect accounts, and select download storage.
- For local Navo 2.12.x development installations, download 1.0.0 manually: the update checker will not offer a lower version. On Windows, back up settings and uninstall the development installer before installing 1.0.0. Android build 66 can update build 65 when signed with the same key.
- Aurral requires version 3.x. Server-backed features depend on provider capabilities and account permissions; sonic discovery requires compatible similarity data.
- Generated-station settings use sync schema 2. Use Navo 1.0.0 on devices sharing those settings or transferring stations. Older settings imports remain readable; removed split-view and player-layout preferences are ignored.

## Known issues

- Windows downloads are not publisher-signed and may show an operating-system security warning.
- Only Windows x64 and Android packages are released. No Navo store listing, macOS, Linux, iOS, or Apple TV download is included; retained platform sources do not establish release support.
- Navo Connect remains beta. Google Cast requires compatible online media and a reachable receiver. Vehicle displays and Android Auto availability depend on the head unit; physical vehicle acceptance is not established by emulator checks.

## Inherited contribution details

- Radio, TV, playback, lyrics, testing, and Brazilian Portuguese translation work by @crsthn-slv is inherited from Naviamp. The [upstream release record](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/releases/tag/v2.11.0) links the originating issues and implementation PRs.
- Android startup recovery when the Cast module is unavailable was reported by @sewnie and implemented upstream. ([Issue #391](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/391), [PR #479](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/479))
- These are existing upstream contributors, not new first-time acknowledgments.

## Downloads and details

- [Download Navo v1.0.0](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/releases/tag/v1.0.0): Android APK and Windows x64 ZIP, MSI, and EXE. Android requires 8.0/API 26 or newer. Windows ZIP includes Java; extract the entire archive before running Navo.exe.
- Android: allow APK installation from the selected download source. The same package serves phones, tablets, and TVs. Windows: use either installer or the portable ZIP.
- [Installation and compatibility](https://github.com/tamlok/navo#platforms-and-downloads) and [release readiness](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/blob/main/docs/releases/v1.0.0-readiness.md).
- This is the first Navo release, so there is no previous Navo release comparison. [Complete source history](https://github.com/tamlok/navo/commits/v1.0.0/).
